effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When you play a [Groundramon], this Digimon may digivolve into a [Wingdramon] from your hand for a cost of 3, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When you play a [Groundramon], this Digimon may digivolve into a [Wingdramon] from your hand without paying its cost.
